skills/.github/skills

12 files in this folder are published on this site.

  • Concise handoff concise-handoff/SKILL.mdWrite a short, evidence-backed engineering handoff. Use for completion reports, implementation summaries, remaining-work notes, or replacing verbose unsupported claims.
  • Dependency reality check dependency-reality-check/SKILL.mdVerify package and API recommendations before installation. Use when an agent suggests a dependency, invents an SDK method, or adds packages for functionality already available.
  • Evidence first evidence-first/SKILL.mdGround factual claims in inspectable evidence. Use when checking citations, API behavior, invented facts, unsupported documentation, or confidently wrong AI output.
  • Failure paths failure-paths/SKILL.mdDesign and test explicit failure behavior. Use when code swallows errors, returns success-shaped defaults, conflates empty data with failure, or ignores invalid input.
  • Grill me grill-me/SKILL.mdStress-test a request, plan, or design before implementation. Use when asked to grill me, challenge assumptions, clarify ambiguity, or interview me about trade-offs.
  • Repository conventions repo-conventions/SKILL.mdAlign a change with local engineering patterns. Use before introducing new naming, helpers, dependencies, error handling, test style, or architecture into an existing codebase.
  • Review feedback review-feedback/SKILL.mdEvaluate code review feedback against requirements and tests before applying it. Use when feedback conflicts, suggests an unneeded change, or an agent agrees without checking.
  • Scope contract scope-contract/SKILL.mdTurn agreed requirements into a small observable contract. Use when defining acceptance criteria, non-goals, edge cases, or preventing scope creep before coding.
  • Simplify first simplify-first/SKILL.mdReduce over-engineering while preserving observable behavior. Use when an AI adds unnecessary frameworks, generic factories, options, abstractions, or large diffs for a small request.
  • Systematic debugging systematic-debugging/SKILL.mdInvestigate root causes before changing code. Use for failing tests, unexpected behavior, flaky fixes, boundary errors, or repeated speculative patches.
  • Test-driven development test-driven-development/SKILL.mdUse before implementing a feature or bug fix: write a behavioral test, observe the intended failure, make the smallest passing change, and verify regressions.
  • Verification before completion verification-before-completion/SKILL.mdRequire fresh evidence before saying a change is done, fixed, or passing. Use before completion reports, handoffs, commits, or claims that requirements are met.

Walkthroughs and studio scenes are illustrative, not recorded Copilot output. Only the Commands lab GIFs show real check results, re-run by the recorder before each capture. No productivity statistics are claimed.
